blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Mandaue City is urging its 27 barangays to intensify dengue prevention measures, strengthen community surveillance and improve early detection following a meeting with barangay captains on Tuesday afternoon, November 24. Dr. Phyllis Bidon, assistant Mandaue City health officer, said the meeting focused on addressing the city’s rising dengue cases and deaths, as well as hospital congestion caused by the increasing number of dengue patients. Bidon said the primary concern was to strengthen preparedness at the community and barangay levels, particularly by intensifying efforts to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and reminding residents to practice preventive measures.
